author: assistant visual review, not maker annotation or ground truth
protocol: Intervals selected from raw rectified strips without original/corrected overlays or reading predicted edge offsets. Prior whole-image corrections were already known, so review is not observer-blind. Each interval describes plausible bead/paper transition at tangent=0; local bead scallops are included, not an inferred smooth envelope.

A.note: Moderate blur at both edges; top reference.

B.note: Outer dark bead and inner dark bead against brighter paper.

C.note: Inner reddish/yellow bead blends into colored shadow.

D.note: Dark inner bead has a broad ambiguous transition.

E.note: Outer scallop/notch at the transect; inner dark bead merges with shadow.

F.note: Yellow outer edge and dark inner edge; useful reference.

G.note: Outer scallop; inner yellow/dark bead against shadow.

H.note: Outer black bead tip; inner dark bead/shadow transition.

I.note: Blurred bottom contour, especially the inner dark bead.

J.note: Outer red bead in shadow; inner yellow bead against brighter paper.

K.note: Outer yellow bead merges into brown shadow; bright inner yellow edge.

L.note: Outer red/dark bead in shadow; brighter inner edge.
